notablePrerequisites:
Deadeye Navigator paired with another creature.
Creatures you control can tap for at least enough mana to activate your blink effect.
description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to activate Deadeye Navigator.
Pay the mana cost to activate Deadeye Navigator or the soulbound creature, blinking that creature.
Deadeye Navigator and Intruder Alarm both trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator ETB, pairing it with another creature you control.
Repeat.
